# Best slim Qi2/MagSafe power banks for iPhone 17

**My pick: Anker Nano Power Bank (5K, MagGo, Slim), $54.99**
- It's 0.34" thick and weighs 4.3 oz, with 15W Qi2 wireless charging and 5,000mAh of capacity.
- 9to5Mac calls it the closest alternative to Apple's own MagSafe battery, and says it runs cooler than the competition.
- Anker lists it as a fit for the iPhone 17 series.
- [Buy at Anker](https://www.anker.com/products/a1665-5k-ultra-slim-qi2-power-bank)

**Other slim options**

| Pick | Thickness / weight | Wireless | Capacity | Price |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **INIU SnapGo Air**, best slim 10K | 0.5" / 195g | 25W Qi2.2 | 10,000mAh | $42.99 at Amazon |
| **Baseus Picogo Air AM71**, thinnest and lightest | 0.27" / 104g | 7.5W only | 5,000mAh | $52.99 at Amazon |
| **ReelCharge ReelSafe**, solid-state | 0.35" / 119g | 15W | 5,000mAh | $49.99 |
| **TORRAS MiniMag Pro**, water-resistant (IP54) | 0.57" / 195g | 15W | 10,000mAh | $69.99 |

- The INIU also has 45W wired output and a built-in lanyard-style cable. Macworld lists it as tied for the slimmest 10K power bank.
- The Baseus is the thinnest and lightest, but its slow 7.5W wireless speed is the trade-off.
- Prices and specs for these four come from [Android Central's roundup](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge), which has the retailer links. I couldn't get direct product links for them from the results.
- Macworld's [full roundup](https://www.macworld.com/article/668978/feature-best-magsafe-magnetic-portable-battery-packs-power-banks-for-iphone.html) has more 10K picks.

**Which to choose**
- **Slimmest at a decent speed:** the Anker Nano 5K.
- **More capacity without much bulk:** the INIU SnapGo Air. Your iPhone 17 can take the full 25W Qi2.2 speed from it.
- **Thinnest and lightest, speed doesn't matter:** the Baseus Picogo Air.

**Things to know**
- A 5K pack usually gives a 60–75% recharge. A 10K pack gives close to two full charges (Macworld).
- Thick or non-magnetic cases, and metal attachments like cards or pop grips, can interfere with charging. Anker says cases over 2.5 mm may weaken the connection.

**Possible discount:** Dealectric reports that code AM52 takes $6 off the Baseus PicoGo AM52 Qi2.2 10K (45W wired), bringing it from $59.99 to $53.99. I couldn't confirm its thickness, so check that before buying. [Dealectric link to Baseus's store](https://dealectric.com/go/baseus-picogo-am52-qi2-2-10000mah-45w) (affiliate link; the store's checkout has the final word on the price).
